name: doors
description: Ten skills for making a website something an agent can walk into: an audit that grades any origin the way aadhar.sh/lens does, discovery files (llms.txt, sitemap, robots), Markdown twins with correct Accept negotiation, MCP doors with generated cards, shared-dictionary delivery, IndieWeb (h-card, rel=me, webmentions), crawler policy read with controls, agent identity (Web Bot Auth, agent card, DNS-AID), NLWeb /ask graded per field, and wire weight (who compressed, immutable assets, Early Hints, speculation, CSP by hash). Every skill ships a probe with a control first and a reference as the fallback.
